facts.title: 5 things your pet wants to tell you
facts.subtitle: Swipe to discover them 👉

pet_facts.text: Dogs can distinguish up to 340 different breeds, each with unique exercise needs.
A dog can learn more than 165 words, numbers, and gestures. The smartest can learn up to 250!
Dogs sweat through their paws. That's why they leave wet footprints in summer!
A dog's sense of smell is 100,000 times more powerful than humans'. They can smell your emotions!
Puppies are born deaf, blind, and toothless. But in 3 weeks they're total explorers!
A Golden Retriever can carry an egg in its mouth without breaking it. As delicate as they are strong!
Dogs drink water by forming a spoon with their tongue backward. Canine engineering!
The world's fastest dog (Greyhound) can run at 72 km/h. Faster than Usain Bolt!
Dogs have three eyelids: two you see and one extra to protect their eyes while playing.
One human year does NOT equal 7 dog years. The first 2 years count more!
Cats spend 70% of their life sleeping. That's like 13-16 hours a day of napping!
A cat can rotate its ears 180 degrees. They have 32 muscles in each ear!
Cats have more than 100 vocal sounds. Dogs only have 10!
A cat's purr vibrates at 25-150 Hz, a frequency that can help heal bones and tissues.
Cats can jump up to 6 times their height. They're natural Olympic athletes!
Pets reduce stress by 50%. Your furry friend is your best therapist!
Animals can detect diseases before doctors. Their sense of smell detects chemical changes!
Having a pet improves your immune system. Children with pets have fewer allergies!
Pets synchronize their heart rate with their owners'. Real connection!
A study showed that petting your pet reduces your blood pressure in minutes.
